unknown: No pressure data is filed, so there is no rate transient analysis and no material balance. Nothing here independently confirms the volume a well is draining.
No seismic. Structure comes from well picks alone, so it is only as dense as the drilling and says nothing between control points.
No core, porosity or saturation in the public record. This model carries where formations are, not what they hold.
Lateral length is not published. Perforated interval stands in for it, which is a proxy and not a measurement.
Well cost is not public. Every economic figure is a parameter.
Formation picks were made by different people over sixty years with no common standard, and their quality varies accordingly.
